## Spicy EX 1.6.1 — first fork release

Everything below was built in this fork on top of upstream Spicy EX 1.58.x. It installs as a normal
module update (signed with this fork's key, so uninstall once if you ran an earlier unsigned/debug build).

### Lyrics screen
- **Apple Music-style motion**: cascade, spring strength, lift, line slide and word bounce, each tunable.
- **Playback sync follows Spotify's audio clock** (heard position, speed-aware): no more drift over a song, correct after seeks, pauses and speed changes.
- **Scrolling**: momentum carries between swipes, smooth hand-over between fingers, and lines dissolve into the background at the screen edge.
- **Tap to seek** (off / single / double tap), **sync offset** ±5000 ms, and a **Reset lyrics sync** action.
- **Follow chip**: jumps back to the current line after you scroll away; waveform icon that collapses to a round button; optional auto-resume.
- **Auto-skip / Skip outro chip**: the outro skip seeks to the end of the song, so it works on free accounts and spends no skip.
- Empty-state screen when a song has no lyrics.
- **More lyrics sources**: NetEase and QQ Music, plus a per-song source picker (choose, reject a wrong match, clear saved lyrics).

### Layout Editor
Edit the lyrics screen in place: artwork, track text, focus point, text, background, skip chip, follow chip, top controls and the now-playing card. Position, size and style change live; Reset restores defaults. Anything the editor covers is no longer duplicated in Settings.

### Double-tap like
- Double-tap the lyrics to like the song, with a burst where your finger landed (it never removes a like; taps right after a like never seek).
- 14 effect styles: Aurora, Glow, Pulse, Watercolor, Radiant, Stardust, Gravity, Crystal, Liquid, Lens, Pearl, Prism, Bloom, Classic.
- Mark: Like button, Heart or Star. **Try it** opens a trial bar to preview every style without liking anything.

### Share cards
Share a lyric as an image: Glass, Classic, Minimal, Polaroid, Poster, Vinyl and Ticket designs, blurred artwork / lyrics / artist-photo backdrop, optional Spotify code, pick several lines, save to gallery, copy link, and Instagram / Facebook Stories buttons. Opens instantly and no longer blocks on the blur.

### Picture-in-Picture
Lyrics in a floating window from a dedicated button or when you leave the lyrics screen. Song-info header, landscape layout with artwork column and larger text, several window shapes, lighter and faster to open; the mini player opens Spotify's own page.

### Ad-free listening
Mute ads or replace the break with soft generated music (Lofi, Cafe jazz, Bossa nova, Ambient, random). Only Spotify's audio is muted. An ad card with the time left appears on the lyrics screen.

### Spicy Connect
A background web player shows up as a Spotify Connect device you can cast to (ads stripped). Sign in from Settings, choose when playback is handed over (app start / first play), reconnect after network changes, and get a banner when playback moves to another device. The player stops with Spotify and exits when idle.

### Settings and app
- Settings is now a bottom sheet with search, regrouped pages and an About page that checks the latest release.
- Fork versioning: version code follows the commit count, so every build updates cleanly.
- Interface language: English, Korean, Japanese (this release completes both), Russian, Simplified Chinese.
- Lighter hooks and fixes for Spotify 9.1.88.

Language model pack (readings) is the separate `v1` release and is downloaded from Settings.
